Saudi Arabia’s food and beverage (F&B) market was valued at approximately 200 billion SAR in 2023.
Riyadh accounts for roughly 35 % of the national F&B consumption, reflecting its status as the economic and population hub.
Key competitors for a specialty coffee shop in Riyadh include international chains such as Starbucks and Costa Coffee, as well as local cafés like Al Mamlakah and Al Safa.
